summary: Vistance Networks, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 1, 2026, announcing the completion of the sale of its RUCKUS reporting segment to Belden Inc. The transaction was previously disclosed in an 8-K filed May 5, 2026. Pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, Belden acquired the business on a cash-free, debt-free basis for $1.846 billion in cash, subject to adjustments. Vistance acted as seller. The disposal is now closed; no advisory or recommendation details are in this filing. No structural or regulatory conditions remain. Watch for Vistance's deployment of sale proceeds.
